---
title: "Climograma de Walter-Lieth para Mazamitla, Jal."
author: "Viacheslav Shalisko"
output: html_document
date: "2026-10-06"
---

## Datos climaticos

```{r data}
nombre <- "Mazamitla, Jal. (14099)"
periodo <- "1971-2000"
elevacion <- 2240

prec <- c(36,10.5,6.3,9.9,39.9,174,223.4,186.3,148.1,93.2,30.9,16.9)
tmin <- c(5.9,6.5,8.2,9.9,11.1,12,11.6,11.6,11.4,9.8,8.3,7.1)
tmax <- c(20,21.7,24.4,26.5,27.3,24.2,21.3,21.4,21.2,21.6,21.2,20.1)
tminabs <- c(-3,1,1,1,2,5,6,6,4,2,0,-3)
tmaxabs <- c(28,30,34,39,36,35,29,28,29,29.5,28,28)

meses <- c("J", "F", "M", "A", "M", "J", "J", "A", "S", "O", "N", "D")
```

## Definición de variables

```{r}
# --- 2. Cálculos generales ---
tmedia <- (tmax + tmin)/2
tdif <- (tmax - tmin)
tdif_prom <- round(mean(tdif), 1)
temp_prom <- round(mean(tmedia), 1)
prec_anual <- round(sum(prec), 0)
max_tmax <- max(tmax)
min_tmin <- min(tmin)

# --- 2. Escala Gaussen-Walter e Interpolación Densa ---
# Transformación de precipitación a escala de temperatura:
# 0 a 100 mm -> 0 a 50°C (relación 2:1)
# > 100 mm -> escala reducida (10 mm extra = 2°C)
p_escala <- ifelse(prec <= 100, prec / 2, 50 + (prec - 100) / 10)

# Secuancias de valores para los poligonos de relleno
xd <- seq(1, 12, length.out = 500)
td <- approx(1:12, tmedia, xout = xd)$y
pd <- approx(1:12, p_escala, xout = xd)$y
```

## Climograma

```{r climograma, fig.width=7, fig.height = 6}
# --- 3. Configuración del Gráfico ---
par(mar = c(4, 6.5, 4, 4.5), mgp = c(2.5, 0.7, 0), cex=0.8)

plot(1:12, tmedia, type = "n", xlim = c(0.5, 12.5), ylim = c(0, max(c(p_escala, 70))),
     axes = FALSE, xlab = "", ylab = "")

# Colores semitransparentes
col_arido  <- adjustcolor("#D92121", alpha.f = 0.35) # Rojo semitransparente (Árido)
col_humedo <- adjustcolor("#0052CC", alpha.f = 0.35) # Azul semitransparente (Húmedo)
col_super  <- adjustcolor("#0052CC", alpha.f = 0.85) # Azul intesificado (Superhúmedo)

# --- 4. Relleno Uniforme de Áreas ---
# A) Período árido (T > P)
m_arid <- td >= pd
polygon(c(xd[m_arid], rev(xd[m_arid])), 
        c(td[m_arid], rev(pd[m_arid])), 
        col = col_arido, border = NA,
        density = 15, angle = 90)

# B) Período húmedo (P > T, hasta 100 mm / 50°C)
m_humid <- pd >= td
p_lim <- pmin(pd, 50)
polygon(c(xd[m_humid], rev(xd[m_humid])), 
        c(p_lim[m_humid], rev(td[m_humid])), 
        col = col_humedo, border = NA,
        density = 15, angle = 90)

# C) Período superhúmedo (> 100 mm / 50°C)
m_super <- pd >= 50
polygon(c(xd[m_super], rev(xd[m_super])), 
        c(pd[m_super], rep(50, sum(m_super))), 
        col = col_super, border = NA)

# --- 5. Rectángulos de Heladas bajo el eje horizontal ---
for (i in 1:12) {
  if (tmin[i] <= 0) {
    # Heladas seguras (tmin media < 0 °C): Azul sólido
    rect(xleft = i - 0.5, ybottom = -2.5, xright = i + 0.5, ytop = 0, 
         col = "#0052CC", border = "black", xpd = TRUE)
  } else if (tminabs[i] <= 0) {
    # Heladas probables (tmin absoluta < 0 °C): Azul claro / achurado
    rect(xleft = i - 0.5, ybottom = -2.5, xright = i + 0.5, ytop = 0, 
         col = adjustcolor("#0052CC", alpha.f = 0.3), density = 15, angle = 45, 
         border = "black", xpd = TRUE)
  }
}

# --- 6. Líneas, Ejes y Encabezados ---
#abline(h = 50, col = "black", lwd = 1)
abline(h = 0, col = "black", lwd = 1)
lines(1:12, p_escala, col = "#0052CC", lwd = 2)
lines(1:12, tmedia, col = "#D92121", lwd = 2)

# Ejes
axis(1, at = 1:12, labels = meses, cex.axis = 1.1)
axis(2, at = c(seq(0, 50, 10)), col.axis = "#D92121", las = 1)
axis(4, at = c(seq(0, 50, 10), 60, 70), labels = c(seq(0, 100, 20), 200, 300), col.axis = "#0052CC", las = 1)

# Etiquetas de unidades
mtext("°C", side = 2, at = 74, col = "#D92121", line = 1, las = 1)
mtext("mm", side = 4, at = 74, col = "#0052CC", line = 1, las = 1)

# Marco exterior
axis(2, at = c(0, 70), labels = FALSE)
axis(4, at = c(0, 70), labels = FALSE)

# Títulos y Metadatos
mtext(paste0(nombre, " (", elevacion, " m)"), side = 3, line = 2.5, adj = 0)
mtext(paste0("[",periodo,"]"), side = 3, line = 1, adj = 0)
mtext(substitute(paste("T"["media"],"=", Tmean, "°C"),
                 list(Tmean=temp_prom)),
      side = 3, line = 2.5, adj = 1)
mtext(substitute(paste("P"["anual"]," = ", P, " mm"),
                 list(P=prec_anual)),
      side = 3, line = 1, adj = 1)

# Indicadores laterales Max/Min
## Maximo absoluto
mtext(expression("T"["max"]), side = 2, at = 37, 
      line = 2.5, las = 1, adj = 1, cex = 0.9)
mtext(sprintf("%.1f", max(tmax)), side = 2, at = 34, 
      line = 2.5, las = 1, adj = 1, cex = 0.9)
## Maximo mensual
mtext(expression("T"["min"]), side = 2, at = 17, 
      line = 2.5, las = 1, adj = 1, cex = 0.9)
mtext(sprintf("%.1f", min(tmin)), side = 2, at = 14, 
      line = 2.5, las = 1, adj = 1, cex = 0.9)
## Rango diurno
mtext(expression("T"["dif"]), side = 2, at = 27, 
      line = 2.5, las = 1, adj = 1, cex = 0.9)
mtext(sprintf("%.1f", mean(tdif)), side = 2, at = 24, 
      line = 2.5, las = 1, adj = 1, cex = 0.9)
## Minimo mensual
mtext(expression("T"["max abs"]), side = 2, at = 47, 
      line = 2.5, las = 1, adj = 1, cex = 0.9)
mtext(sprintf("%.1f", max(tmaxabs)), side = 2, at = 44, 
      line = 2.5, las = 1, adj = 1, cex = 0.9)
## Minimo absoluto
mtext(expression("T"["min abs"]), side = 2, at = 7, 
      line = 2.5, las = 1, adj = 1, cex = 0.9)
mtext(sprintf("%.1f", min(tminabs)), side = 2, at = 4, 
      line = 2.5, las = 1, adj = 1, cex = 0.9)
```
